title: Chess single-player websocket contract
description: Exact payload contract currently implemented by the SignalR hub for a single player vs engine game.

clientToServer.description: Starts or resumes a game. The server resolves the session id from the payload or the chess_session_id cookie.
Submits a move for the active session. The server validates it and either updates the game or returns a move-status error.

serverToClient.description: The server emits one concrete payload at a time. The payload is not wrapped in a Type/Data envelope.

piece.type: Pawn | Rook | Knight | Bishop | Queen | King
piece.letterId: P | R | N | B | Q | K

shape.status: InProgress | WhiteWon | BlackWon | DrawByStalemate | DrawByInsufficientMaterial | DrawByThreefoldRepetition | DrawBy75MoveRule

payloads.description: Error message sent when the game cannot be started, the session is missing, the move is rejected due to lifecycle state, or another server-side issue occurs.

sessionBehavior: A session is created when StartGame is called with a new session id.
The session id is stored in the chess_session_id cookie and reused on reconnect.
The server keeps the session in memory in GameSessionManager.
Once the snapshot status is no longer InProgress, the game is treated as complete and the session is effectively closed.
